items.q: Why is GenAI cost different from classic ML?
items.a: The bill **grows with every use**, so success makes it more expensive.

items.q: What did switching to a cheaper model reveal?
items.a: The win came from **the model, not the concept**. Fast eval loops then found a cheap option that worked.

items.q: What can block a global rollout?
items.a: **AI regulation differs by market**, so plan compliance from the start.
